description: Add a VIRTUAL till — a browser-based station, the cabinet’s "Add Virtual Station". It is created at one outlet and starts AVAILABLE. You CANNOT create a native (device) station from here and must not try: a physical till enrols itself when someone opens the POS app on the device and names it there. THIS IS BILLABLE — a new station counts against the company plan’s station allowance and the call is refused once that allowance is used up. Confirm with the merchant before calling. flowSrcId is the POS layout the till runs. The cabinet’s wizard makes picking one mandatory and there is no tool here that lists flows, so unless the merchant gave you an id, create the station and then tell them plainly to open Run → Stations and choose the flow — until they do, the station exists but cannot be launched.

flowSrcId.description: Id of the POS layout (flow) the till runs, if the merchant gave one

name.description: Station name as staff will see it, e.g. "POS 2"

outletId.description: Which outlet this till belongs to — id from get_outlets, not a name

name: hub_create_station
title: Add virtual till
